test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends Aman, Biraj, Chaman, Sourav and Rajesh are seating around a circular table facing the centre. Aman is to the immediate right of Chaman who is second to the right of Sourav, Biraj is to the immediate left of Chaman. Who is second to the right of Aman?
solution:
Given: Five friends Aman, Biraj, Chaman, Sourav and Rajesh.

1) Aman is to the immediate right of Chaman who is second to the right of Sourav.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb2e09d3589587b51760d9c519211abf76824293c5c45cbba4c679b4073c063.png] 

2) Biraj is to the immediate left of Chaman.

And, Rajesh sits on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4df225feb62c02242ea232223835b990672cd1aad308dfbf5bbc0fc1b15d68e4.png] 

Here, 'Sourav' is second to the right of Aman.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
